actions.description: View data, list stored files and check background job status
Create and modify records, files and notifications
Authorise transfers of funds between accounts

environment.name: DEMO_VOLUME
environment.description: Volume code used by the file, PDF and Excel handlers

environment.name: DEBUG_LEVEL
environment.description: Backend log verbosity: none | error | warn | info | debug (each level includes the levels above it). Unset defaults to error.

documentdb.description: Document store for the note CRUD handlers (binds to the derived APP_DATA_DOCDB)

volume.description: Demo file storage for saved files, PDFs and spreadsheets

secret.description: Demo secret read by the getSecret handler (binds to the derived APIKEY_SECRET)

parameter.description: Shared, unencrypted JSON configuration read by the Parameter handlers (binds to the derived APP_SETTINGS_PARAMETER)

connection.description: SQL data connection queried by the database handlers (binds to the derived MAIN_DB_CONNECTION)

roles.name: Editor
roles.description: Can read, modify data and generate exports

roles.name: Approver
roles.description: Can read and authorise transfers, but not modify other data
